source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The historical shortcut handler adds a tabmail.globalOverlay guard before preventDefault, stopPropagation and dispatch. The accepted module retains that boundary with later main-window lookup, optional access and repeat filtering. Returning here skips this dispatcher; it does not establish that all key handlers or native default actions are blocked. Keep the first landing, backout and later revised landing separate from the shared command-controller lifecycle.
title: An overlay guard skips shortcut dispatch before the event is consumed
